The district hospital's generator hall in Aurelia is destroyed. 53 dead.
Wire services report continued exchanges across the strait.

transcript: Aurelia gives ground on The Meridian Cable, The Anvil Removals.
Aurelia holds out for The Kestrel Line, Bellow Reef, Halcyon Seven.

world.outcome: Aurelia has lost its capital to the crowd outside it and Korsav is in ruins. Nothing is left of either. Nobody won.

west.name: Aurelia
west.blurb: Northern maritime republic. Rich, exporting, and answerable to its own press.

east.name: Korsav
east.blurb: Southern military state. Poorer, armed to the teeth, and difficult to embarrass.
